## Joins

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
# opsjoner
options(paged.print = FALSE)
```

```{r}
X <- tibble(
  key = paste0("k", seq(1, 7, by = 2)),
  xx = paste0("x", 1:4)
)

X
```

```{r}
Y <- tibble(
  key = paste0("k", 1:6),
  xy = paste0("x", 1:6)
)

Y
```

### Left Join

All Xs.

```{r}
left_join(
  x = X,
  y = Y,
  by = join_by(key)
)
```

### Right Join

All Ys

```{r}
right_join(
  x = X,
  y = Y,
  by = join_by(key)
)
```

### Inner Join

Those that are in both X and Y

```{r}
inner_join(
  x = X,
  y = Y,
  by = join_by(key)
)
```

### Full Join

All combinations of X and Y

```{r}
full_join(
  x = X,
  y = Y,
  by = join_by(key)
) |> 
  arrange(key)
```


## Flights example

```{r}
# it's a tibble
flights |> class()
```

```{r}
flights |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
airlines |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
airports |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
weather |> head(n = 3)
```

```{r}
flights <- flights %>% 
  # note x = flights, y = airlines
  left_join(
    y = airlines, 
    by = join_by("carrier")
    )
```

```{r}
flights %>% 
  select(carrier, name, everything()) %>% 
  head(3)
```

We have to check names. Do any overlap. Do they have the same content. If so they might be used as a key. If not we have to be careful and use prefix/suffix to keep them distinct.

```{r}
# alternative
intersect(names(flights), names(planes))
```

Year has different meaning in the two tables, 2013 in flights (of no importance) the year an aircraft was built in the *planes* table.

#### suffix

```{r}
tmp <- flights %>% 
  left_join(planes, by = join_by("tailnum"), 
            suffix = c("", "_plane"))

tmp %>% 
  select(tailnum, model, 
         year_plane, year, everything()) %>% 
  head(n = 3) |> 
  print(width = 80)
```

Seems to work so I do:

```{r}
flights <- flights %>% 
  left_join(planes, by = join_by("tailnum"), 
            suffix = c("", "_plane"))
```

i.e. update flights

```{r}

(x <- sample(flights$dep_time, size = 30)) |> 
  print(width = 80)
```

```{r}
str_pad(x, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0") |> 
  print(width = 80)
```

```{r}
x |> 
str_pad(width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0") |> 
str_sub(start = 1, end = 2) |> 
as.numeric() |> 
print(width = 80)
```

```{r}
fix_dep_time <- function(x) {
  x = str_pad(x, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0")
  x = str_sub(x, start = 1, end = 2)
  # This is correct since hour 0: 23 in weather dataset
  # Note that not all days have hour = 0
  x = as.integer(x)
  return(x)
  }
```

```{r}
flights <- flights %>% 
  mutate(
    dep_time_hour = fix_dep_time(dep_time)
  )
```

```{r}
intersect(names(flights), names(weather))
```

```{r}
flights <- flights %>% 
  left_join(weather, 
            #by = c("origin", "year", "month", "day", "dep_time_hour" = "hour"),
            by = join_by(origin, year, month, day, dep_time_hour == hour),
            suffix = c("", "_weather"), 
            keep = FALSE
            )
```

```{r}
flights <- flights %>% 
  select(year, month, day, dep_time, everything())

flights %>%  print(width = 80)
```

```{r}
flights |> 
  names()
```
